Three commitments, held as operating standards
IAQ integrates environmental, social and corporate governance principles into every project. Built into the way the work is run, every day.
ENVIRONMENTAL
Sustainable by design
Building sustainably and reducing our footprint.
SOCIAL
People first
Protecting our people and giving back to our communities.
GOVERNANCE
Doing business the right way
Operating with transparency and integrity.

sections.heading: Sustainable by design
sections.text:
Sustainable by design
We build with energy efficiency in mind. From eco-friendly materials to smarter cooling systems that cut long-term energy use.
IAQ is dedicated to minimising its environmental footprint through sustainable design and construction practice, continually seeking energy-efficient solutions and prioritising eco-friendly technologies. Impact is managed under ISO 14001: waste minimisation, resource conservation and energy-efficient engineering on every site.
ON THE RECORD
CARBON
20 tonnes of carbon footprint reduced per annum.
STANDARD
ISO 14001:2015 environmental management, certified by Intertek.
ENERGY
Energy management offered as a service, funded by IAQ, paid from the saving.

sections.heading: People first
sections.text:
People first
Safe workplaces, an inclusive culture, and giving back, through community outreach like our visits to PDK Kota Raja and House of Love.
IAQ prioritises the wellbeing and safety of its employees and the communities around its sites, promotes a diverse and inclusive work environment, and upholds ethical labour practice across the group.
Safety comes first
We believe every incident is preventable. No task is worth risking someone’s safety.
ON THE RECORD
SAFETY
2.6 million safe manhours achieved on the East Malaysia wafer fab expansion.
RECOGNITION
Gold Award for OSH Management, 20th OSH Excellence Awards 2024, and recognition from the Department of Occupational Safety and Health (DOSH) in Kuching in July 2025.
STANDARD
ISO 45001:2018 occupational health and safety, certified by Intertek.
PEOPLE
450 people group-wide, and a strategic collaboration with University of Malaya.

sections.heading: Doing business the right way
sections.text:
Doing business the right way
Transparency and accountability guide every decision, backed by our published Quality and environment, health and safety (EHS) policies.
IAQ’s governance practice is built for transparency, accountability and ethical decision-making. It follows the compliance standards that earn the trust of clients, partners and stakeholders, and that a public company is judged by.
